build_system: bun (bun.lock present), next build via bun run build
test_framework: No test framework configured in package.json
verification_instructions: Run bun run build and verify it completes without errors. Run bun run lint for linting.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No npm available, use bun. No gh CLI authenticated. GitHub write operations only via kiro power tools (push_to_remote, create_pull_request). No create_issue tool available in the GitHub power.
contribution_requirements: Use bun run build and bun run lint for verification. PR title under 70 chars.
key_patterns: API route at app/api/riot/route.ts handles RiotApiError with status codes. lib/riot-api.ts has riotFetch that throws RiotApiError(500) for missing key, RiotApiError(403) for invalid/expired key. Route returns 503 with user-friendly message for 401/403.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js app router pages and API routes; lib/ - shared utilities and Riot API client; public/ - static assets
